title: How Did Tang Dynasty Officials Work?
synopsis: Life is good if you’re an official in the Tang dynasty (618–907).

fullText.simplified:
唐朝的官员如何上班

    唐朝是中国历史长河中一颗极为璀璨的明珠，国力达到了前所未有的强盛。
    那唐朝的官员是如何上班的呢？和现代的公务员上班又有什么区别呢？让我们来揭秘一下吧！
    唐朝官员的等级森严，官员的品级按照高低依次是一品到九品。其中一品的官职最大，九品最小。所有的官员都需要去皇宫里上早朝，也就是和皇帝开早会。
    九品到五品的官员只需每月初一和十五觐见即可。五品以上的官员则每天都需要出席早朝。
    早朝的时间一般为早上六点半到八点。早朝结束后官员就回到自己的岗位上处理公务。若公务处理完毕，官员在下午三点左右就可以回家了。所以唐朝官员一天差不多也是八个小时的工作量。
    唐朝实行的是“旬假”制度，即每月的第十天、第二十天以及最后一天为休息日。另外在二十四节气时也有休假，二十四节气的假期共计四十七天。唐朝时期是以农业为主的，官员到了农忙的时候也得回家种田、收获庄稼。农忙时官员有十五天的假期。唐朝官员林林总总的假期共计一百二十天左右，几乎是一年的三分之一时间。所以唐朝官员很有闲情逸致去吟诗作赋，游山玩水。
   唐朝官员的俸禄非常优厚。九品官员一年的俸禄折合成人民币将近十三万。一品官员一年的俸禄折合成人民币高达一百七十万。在那个时期，收入可谓是相当丰厚了。让人匪夷所思的是唐朝官员竟然可以合法公款吃喝。这种行为放到现在是严重违法违纪的。
    总而言之，在盛唐时期，官员们的幸福指数相对来说是比较高的。
fullText.traditional:
唐朝的官員如何上班

    唐朝是中國歷史長河中一顆極為璀璨的明珠，國力達到了前所未有的強盛。
    那唐朝的官員是如何上班的呢？和現代的公務員上班又有什麼區別呢？讓我們來揭秘一下吧！
    唐朝官員的等級森嚴，官員的品級按照高低依次是一品到九品。其中一品的官職最大，九品最小。所有的官員都需要去皇宮裡上早朝，也就是和皇帝開早會。
    九品到五品的官員只需每月初一和十五覲見即可。五品以上的官員則每天都需要出席早朝。
    早朝的時間一般為早上六點半到八點。早朝結束後官員就回到自己的崗位上處理公務。若公務處理完畢，官員在下午三點左右就可以回家了。所以唐朝官員一天差不多也是八個小時的工作量。
    唐朝實行的是“旬假”制度，即每月的第十天、第二十天以及最後一天為休息日。另外在二十四節氣時也有休假，二十四節氣的假期共計四十七天。唐朝時期是以農業為主的，官員到了農忙的時候也得回家種田、收穫莊稼。農忙時官員有十五天的假期。唐朝官員林林總總的假期共計一百二十天左右，幾乎是一年的三分之一時間。所以唐朝官員很有閒情逸緻去吟詩作賦，遊山玩水。
   唐朝官員的俸祿非常優厚。九品官員一年的俸祿折合成人民幣將近十三萬。一品官員一年的俸祿折合成人民幣高達一百七十萬。在那個時期，收入可謂是相當豐厚了。讓人匪夷所思的是唐朝官員竟然可以合法公款吃喝。這種行為放到現在是嚴重違法違紀的。
    總而言之，在盛唐時期，官員們的幸福指數相對來說是比較高的。

sentences.english: How Did Tang Dynasty Officials Work?

sentences.simplified: 唐朝是中国历史长河中一颗极为璀璨的明珠，
sentences.traditional: 唐朝是中國歷史長河中一顆極為璀璨的明珠，
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo shì zhōng guó lì shǐ cháng hé zhōng yì kē jí wéi cuǐ càn de míng zhū

sentences.simplified: 国力达到了前所未有的强盛。
sentences.traditional: 國力達到了前所未有的強盛。
sentences.pinyin: guó lì dá dào le qián suǒ wèi yǒu de qiáng shèng
sentences.english: In the long river of Chinese history, the Tang Dynasty is an extremely bright pearl.
The nation’s power reached unprecedented strength and prosperity.

sentences.simplified: 那唐朝的官员是如何上班的呢？
sentences.traditional: 那唐朝的官員是如何上班的呢？
sentences.pinyin: nà táng cháo de guān yuán shì rú hé shàng bān de ne

sentences.simplified: 和现代的公务员上班又有什么区别呢？
sentences.traditional: 和現代的公務員上班又有什麼區別呢？
sentences.pinyin: hé xiàn dài de gōng wù yuán shàng bān yòu yǒu shén me qū bié ne
sentences.english: So how did officials in the Tang dynasty work?

sentences.simplified: 让我们来揭秘一下吧！
sentences.traditional: 讓我們來揭秘一下吧！
sentences.pinyin: ràng wǒ men lái jiē mì yí xià ba
sentences.english: Compared to the work of government officials in the modern era, what are the differences?
Let’s go and uncover the secret!

sentences.simplified: 唐朝官员的等级森严，
sentences.traditional: 唐朝官員的等級森嚴，
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo guān yuán de děng jí sēn yán

sentences.simplified: 官员的品级按照高低依次是一品到九品。
sentences.traditional: 官員的品級按照高低依次是一品到九品。
sentences.pinyin: guān yuán de pǐn jí àn zhào gāo dī yī cì shì yī pǐn dào jiǔ pǐn
sentences.english: Tang dynasty officials had strict ranks.

sentences.simplified: 其中一品的官职最大，九品最小。
sentences.traditional: 其中一品的官職最大，九品最小。
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng yī pǐn de guān zhí zuì dà jiǔ pǐn zuì xiǎo
sentences.english: Ranks of officials were ordered from high to low, from Rank 1 to Rank 9.

sentences.simplified: 所有的官员都需要去皇宫里上早朝，
sentences.traditional: 所有的官員都需要去皇宮裡上早朝，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǒu de guān yuán dōu xū yào qù huáng gōng lǐ shàng zǎo cháo
sentences.english: Of these, the position of Rank 1 was the highest, and Rank 9 the lowest.

sentences.simplified: 也就是和皇帝开早会。
sentences.traditional: 也就是和皇帝開早會。
sentences.pinyin: yě jiù shì hé huáng dì kāi zǎo huì
sentences.english: All officials were required to attend morning court in the imperial palace, ..
.. that is, having a morning meeting with the Emperor.

sentences.simplified: 九品到五品的官员只需每月初一和十五觐见即可。
sentences.traditional: 九品到五品的官員只需每月初一和十五覲見即可。
sentences.pinyin: jiǔ pǐn dào wǔ pǐn de guān yuán zhǐ xū měi yuè chū yī hé shí wǔ jìn jiàn jí kě

sentences.simplified: 五品以上的官员则每天都需要出席早朝。
sentences.traditional: 五品以上的官員則每天都需要出席早朝。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ pǐn yǐ shàng de guān yuán zé měi tiān dōu xū yào chū xí zǎo cháo
sentences.english: Rank 9 to Rank 5 officials were only required to have an audience with the Emperor on the first and the fifteenth day of the lunar month.
Officials above Rank 5, however, were required to attend morning court every day.

sentences.simplified: 早朝的时间一般为早上六点半到八点。
sentences.traditional: 早朝的時間一般為早上六點半到八點。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo cháo de shí jiān yì bān wéi zǎo shang liù diǎn bàn dào bā diǎn

sentences.simplified: 早朝结束后官员就回到自己的岗位上处理公务。
sentences.traditional: 早朝結束後官員就回到自己的崗位上處理公務。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo cháo jié shù hòu guān yuán jiù huí dào zì jǐ de gǎng wèi shang chǔ lǐ gōng wù
sentences.english: The morning court generally took place between 6:30 and 8:00 in the morning.

sentences.simplified: 若公务处理完毕，官员在下午三点左右就可以回家了。
sentences.traditional: 若公務處理完畢，官員在下午三點左右就可以回家了。
sentences.pinyin: ruò gōng wù chǔ lǐ wán bì guān yuán zài xià wǔ sān diǎn zuǒ yòu jiù kě yǐ huí jiā le
sentences.english: After the morning court finished, officials immediately returned to their posts to deal with official business.

sentences.simplified: 所以唐朝官员一天差不多也是八个小时的工作量。
sentences.traditional: 所以唐朝官員一天差不多也是八個小時的工作量。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ táng cháo guān yuán yì tiān chà bu duō yě shì bā ge xiǎo shí de gōng zuò liàng
sentences.english: If they had finished their official business, officials were allowed to return home at around 3:30 in the afternoon.
Therefore Tang dynasty officials worked approximately eight hours in one day.

sentences.simplified: 唐朝实行的是“旬假”制度，
sentences.traditional: 唐朝實行的是“旬假”制度，
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo shí xíng de shì xún jià zhì dù

sentences.simplified: 即每月的第十天、第二十天以及最后一天为休息日。
sentences.traditional: 即每月的第十天、第二十天以及最後一天為休息日。
sentences.pinyin: jí měi yuè de dì shí tiān dì èr shí tiān yǐ jí zuì hòu yì tiān wéi xiū xi rì
sentences.english: The Tang dynasty implemented a system of “one day of leave every ten days”.

sentences.simplified: 另外在二十四节气时也有休假，
sentences.traditional: 另外在二十四節氣時也有休假，
sentences.pinyin: lìng wài zài èr shí sì jié qi shí yě yǒu xiū jià
sentences.english: That is, each month, the tenth, twentieth, and last day of the month were rest days.

sentences.simplified: 二十四节气的假期共计四十七天。
sentences.traditional: 二十四節氣的假期共計四十七天。
sentences.pinyin: èr shí sì jié qi de jià qī gòng jì sì shí qī tiān
sentences.english: In addition, there were also vacation days in the twenty-four solar terms.

sentences.simplified: 唐朝时期是以农业为主的，
sentences.traditional: 唐朝時期是以農業為主的，
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo shí qī shì yǐ nóng yè wéi zhǔ de
sentences.english: There were a total of 47 vacation days in the twenty-four solar terms.

sentences.simplified: 官员到了农忙的时候也得回家种田、收获庄稼。
sentences.traditional: 官員到了農忙的時候也得回家種田、收穫莊稼。
sentences.pinyin: guān yuán dào le nóng máng de shí hou yě děi huí jiā zhòng tián shōu huò zhuāng jia
sentences.english: The Tang dynasty period depended mainly on agriculture.

sentences.simplified: 农忙时官员有十五天的假期。
sentences.traditional: 農忙時官員有十五天的假期。
sentences.pinyin: nóng máng shí guān yuán yǒu shí wǔ tiān de jià qī
sentences.english: In busy farming periods, officials must also return home to farm and harvest crops.

sentences.simplified: 唐朝官员林林总总的假期共计一百二十天左右，
sentences.traditional: 唐朝官員林林總總的假期共計一百二十天左右，
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo guān yuán lín lín zǒng zǒng de jià qī gòng jì yì bǎi èr shí tiān zuǒ yòu
sentences.english: Officials had 15 days of holiday for busy farming periods.

sentences.simplified: 几乎是一年的三分之一时间。
sentences.traditional: 幾乎是一年的三分之一時間。
sentences.pinyin: jī hū shì yì nián de sān fēn zhī yī shí jiān
sentences.english: The numerous holidays of Tang dynasty officials totaled approximately 120 days.

sentences.simplified: 所以唐朝官员很有闲情逸致去吟诗作赋，
sentences.traditional: 所以唐朝官員很有閒情逸緻去吟詩作賦，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ táng cháo guān yuán hěn yǒu xián qíng yì zhì qù yín shī zuò fù
sentences.english: This amounted to almost one-third of the year.

sentences.simplified: 游山玩水。
sentences.traditional: 遊山玩水。
sentences.pinyin: yóu shān wán shuǐ
sentences.english: Therefore Tang dynasty officials had the leisurely and carefree mood to recite poetry and compose essays, ..
.. as well as to travel through nature.

sentences.simplified: 唐朝官员的俸禄非常优厚。
sentences.traditional: 唐朝官員的俸祿非常優厚。
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo guān yuán de fèng lù fēi cháng yōu hòu

sentences.simplified: 九品官员一年的俸禄折合成人民币将近十三万。
sentences.traditional: 九品官員一年的俸祿折合成人民幣將近十三萬。
sentences.pinyin: jiǔ pǐn guān yuán yì nián de fèng lù zhé hé chéng rén mín bì jiāng jìn shí sān wàn
sentences.english: Tang dynasty officials’ salaries were extremely generous.

sentences.simplified: 一品官员一年的俸禄折合成人民币高达一百七十万。
sentences.traditional: 一品官員一年的俸祿折合成人民幣高達一百七十萬。
sentences.pinyin: yī pǐn guān yuán yì nián de fèng lù zhé hé chéng rén mín bì gāo dá yì bǎi qī shí wàn
sentences.english: The annual salary of Rank 9 officials was equivalent to nearly 130,000 renminbi.

sentences.simplified: 在那个时期，收入可谓是相当丰厚了。
sentences.traditional: 在那個時期，收入可謂是相當豐厚了。
sentences.pinyin: zài nà ge shí qī shōu rù kě wèi shì xiāng dāng fēng hòu le
sentences.english: The annual salary of Rank 1 officials reached 1.7 million renminbi.

sentences.simplified: 让人匪夷所思的是唐朝官员竟然可以合法公款吃喝。
sentences.traditional: 讓人匪夷所思的是唐朝官員竟然可以合法公款吃喝。
sentences.pinyin: ràng rén fěi yí suǒ sī de shì táng cháo guān yuán jìng rán kě yǐ hé fǎ gōng kuǎn chī hē
sentences.english: In that period, such income could be described as very generous.

sentences.simplified: 这种行为放到现在是严重违法违纪的。
sentences.traditional: 這種行為放到現在是嚴重違法違紀的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng xíng wéi fàng dào xiàn zài shì yán zhòng wéi fǎ wéi jì de
sentences.english: Unbelievably, Tang dynasty officials were allowed to legally use public funds for dining and drinking.
Nowadays, this type of behavior would be a serious violation of the law.

sentences.simplified: 总而言之，在盛唐时期，官员们的幸福指数相对来说是比较高的。
sentences.traditional: 總而言之，在盛唐時期，官員們的幸福指數相對來說是比較高的。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng ér yán zhī zài shèng táng shí qī guān yuán men de xìng fú zhǐ shù xiāng duì lái shuō shì bǐ jiào gāo de

sentences.english: In short, the happiness index of officials during the flourishing Tang era was relatively high.

sentence_translations: How Did Tang Dynasty Officials Work?
In the long river of Chinese history, the Tang Dynasty is an extremely bright pearl.
The nation’s power reached unprecedented strength and prosperity.
So how did officials in the Tang dynasty work?
Compared to the work of government officials in the modern era, what are the differences?
Let’s go and uncover the secret!
Tang dynasty officials had strict ranks.
Ranks of officials were ordered from high to low, from Rank 1 to Rank 9.
Of these, the position of Rank 1 was the highest, and Rank 9 the lowest.
All officials were required to attend morning court in the imperial palace, ..
.. that is, having a morning meeting with the Emperor.
Rank 9 to Rank 5 officials were only required to have an audience with the Emperor on the first and the fifteenth day of the lunar month.
Officials above Rank 5, however, were required to attend morning court every day.
The morning court generally took place between 6:30 and 8:00 in the morning.
After the morning court finished, officials immediately returned to their posts to deal with official business.
If they had finished their official business, officials were allowed to return home at around 3:30 in the afternoon.
Therefore Tang dynasty officials worked approximately eight hours in one day.
The Tang dynasty implemented a system of “one day of leave every ten days”.
That is, each month, the tenth, twentieth, and last day of the month were rest days.
In addition, there were also vacation days in the twenty-four solar terms.
There were a total of 47 vacation days in the twenty-four solar terms.
The Tang dynasty period depended mainly on agriculture.
In busy farming periods, officials must also return home to farm and harvest crops.
Officials had 15 days of holiday for busy farming periods.
The numerous holidays of Tang dynasty officials totaled approximately 120 days.
This amounted to almost one-third of the year.
Therefore Tang dynasty officials had the leisurely and carefree mood to recite poetry and compose essays, ..
.. as well as to travel through nature.
Tang dynasty officials’ salaries were extremely generous.
The annual salary of Rank 9 officials was equivalent to nearly 130,000 renminbi.
The annual salary of Rank 1 officials reached 1.7 million renminbi.
In that period, such income could be described as very generous.
Unbelievably, Tang dynasty officials were allowed to legally use public funds for dining and drinking.
Nowadays, this type of behavior would be a serious violation of the law.
In short, the happiness index of officials during the flourishing Tang era was relatively high.
